gaps.requirement: The six accepted summaries cover same/opposite approach, active/off red signal, pupil/non-pupil stop purpose and stop/pass. No supplied accepted summary establishes the divided-highway other-roadway exception, traffic-officer control exception, or a comparison of proceeding only after the red signal ceases.
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: The exported accepted-evidence inventory does not demonstrate the listed full-text coverage; new cases or source-backed existing-evidence equivalence must be prepared.

full_text_branch_inventory.branch: Active flashing red front/rear, properly equipped stopped school bus receiving/discharging pupil: meeting and overtaking from both directions; compare stop and pass.
Temporal prohibition on proceeding past bus until flashing red ceases: compare hold until off and early proceed.
Exception: divided highway, bus in other roadway.
Visible lights, pupil purpose and bus equipment role have distinct measured and declared evidence needs.

dev.human_direction.evidence: Preserve the original officer-control actor, control timeline, and source-camera views for independent review.

dev.school_bus_signal.evidence: Join commanded lamp state to original reference-corner and driver-reference camera pixels; physical lamp identity and visibility require Native review.

drv.meeting.evidence: Use original road and heading readback plus subject and bus body tracks to identify opposing approaches.

drv.overtaking.evidence: Use original same-direction road, heading and body tracks to identify passing from behind.

drv.stopped.evidence: Measure subject body motion and velocity over the warning interval without a numerical legal stopping threshold.

kin.velocity.evidence: Measure subject velocity from original time-joined body history and frame map.

rel.same_direction.evidence: Compare bus and subject lane-direction tangents and original body histories on the governed roadway.

ru.child.evidence: Join pupil body motion to bus identity and service interval; pupil purpose remains source-review pending.

ru.school_bus.evidence: Bus actor identity, equipment and roadway stop remain source-review questions.

st.roadway.evidence: Bind bus and subject to original road identifiers and preserve the other-roadway distinction.
